description: Golden set for the FUSED-retrieval eval gate. Each entry maps a realistic vault query to the note(s) that SHOULD be retrieved. Hand-curated across 5 categories (direct, semantic, graph, negative, multi). Grow this over time from real queries + operator corrections. Keep expected_notes as note stems or paths — normalization strips path/case/.md. Graph entries carry seed_notes (the note the query semantically matches, whose wikilinks lead to expected_notes) so the validator can confirm the walk is reachable in CI. See golden_set.README.md for methodology.
